lines.t: You know the more similar the {{medalia}}
you fuse, the stronger the result, right?
But the opposite can happen too.
If you fuse five {{medalia}} that differ from
the base in color, shape, or skills,
you can end up with a {{medalia}} whose
traits have changed from the base.
It's a bit of a gamble with rare {{medalia}},
but if you've got spares, it's worth a try.
Not that I can afford to, though.
